name: Blackaha Pricing Updater for WooCommerce
author: blackaha

sections.description:
Your competitors change their prices every day. Blackaha Pricing Updater makes sure your store answers — automatically.

Connect your WooCommerce store to BlackAha in one click, and your products are repriced by rules you control: follow a specific competitor, beat the lowest price on the market, defend a premium position, or keep a healthy margin no matter what the market does. BlackAha watches the market for you; the plugin applies the result to your store — verified, logged, and safe.

Why stores use it

  • Never sell at yesterday’s price. BlackAha tracks your competitors’ prices continuously. When they move, your store reacts in minutes — not whenever you next find time for a spreadsheet.
  • Price by strategy, not by hand. Decide once how you want to compete; the rules do the daily work across your whole catalog, including product variations.
  • Stay in control. Price limits act as a final safety net on every update, you can preview exactly which products a rule covers, and every change is logged in your WordPress admin with the old price, the new price and the outcome.

Pricing rules, your way

All pricing strategy lives in your BlackAha dashboard, where a visual rule builder covers almost any scenario — no code, no formulas to memorize:

  • Choose the products. Apply a rule set to everything, or narrow it down by SKU, category or brand.
  • Choose your reference. React to the lowest, highest or average competitor price, to one specific competitor’s domain (optionally only while they have stock), to market-based Smart Price profiles (Competitive, Balanced, Premium), or to your own current price.
  • Choose the move. Match a reference price, undercut it by a percentage or a fixed amount, or set a fixed price — with optional rounding up, down or to the nearest value.
  • Combine conditions. “If my price is higher than competitor X, drop to 2% below them; otherwise hold.” Rules are checked top to bottom and the first match wins. If nothing matches, your price simply stays as it is.
  • Set the guardrails. Price limits (floor and ceiling) are always applied last, on every branch, so an aggressive rule can never take a product below the margin you decided to protect.

Multiple rule sets with priorities let you run one strategy for your bestsellers and another for the long tail.

The plugin applies every price carefully

On the store side, the plugin is deliberately strict — it would rather refuse an update and tell you why than guess:

  • Products are matched by SKU, for simple products and individual variations.
  • A running sale is respected: a new price below the regular price becomes the sale price and the regular price is kept; a price at or above the regular price replaces it and ends the sale.
  • Every update is confirmed by reading the price back from the store before it is reported as applied.
  • Each update is applied exactly once, even if it is delivered more than once.
  • It never converts currencies, never rounds beyond your store’s decimal settings, never picks between products sharing a SKU, and never prices a variable product directly (use the variation’s SKU).
  • Connection status and the most recent updates are always visible under WooCommerce → Pricing Updater.

Secure by design

  • One-click connection. Press Connect, approve in your BlackAha account, done — there are no API keys to copy around or accidentally leak.
  • Signed requests only. Every price update is verified against your signing secret, must be recent, and cannot be replayed.
  • A webhook address that can’t be guessed. The endpoint is random and unique to your store.
  • Secrets stay secret. The signing secret is never displayed after the connection is made; reconnecting issues a fresh secret and immediately invalidates the old one.
  • HTTPS only. Price updates are delivered exclusively to sites served over HTTPS.
  • Your customers’ data stays home. The plugin never reads or sends customer or order data — it deals in SKUs and prices, nothing else.

Requirements

  • WooCommerce 8.0 or newer.
  • A site served over HTTPS.
  • A BlackAha account (competitor tracking and pricing rules are configured there).

External services

This plugin connects your store to BlackAha (https://app.blackaha.com), the pricing service that sends the price updates.

When you press Connect, the plugin contacts BlackAha from your server to open the connection and, after you approve it in your BlackAha account, to receive the signing secret. In doing so it sends your site’s address and the addresses of its own endpoints on your site. Nothing else is sent at any other time; the plugin never contacts BlackAha on its own.

From then on, BlackAha calls the webhook endpoint on your site to deliver price updates. Each request is authenticated with your signing secret. The plugin answers with, for each update received: the identifier of the update, whether it was applied, the price now in effect, the WooCommerce product ID, and, when the update was not applied, the reason. No customer or order data is ever read or sent.

BlackAha terms of service: https://blackaha.com/terms-and-conditions/ — privacy policy: https://blackaha.com/privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Open WooCommerce → Pricing Updater and press Connect.
  3. Approve the connection in your BlackAha account — you are brought straight back to your store.
  4. Run the connection test from BlackAha, set up your pricing rules there, and you’re done. There is nothing to copy.
sections.faq:
Do I need a BlackAha account?

Yes. The plugin is the bridge between BlackAha and your store: competitor tracking, market data and pricing rules live in your BlackAha dashboard, and the plugin’s job is to apply the resulting prices to your WooCommerce products safely.

Where do I set up my pricing rules?

In your BlackAha dashboard, under Pricing rules. The visual builder lets you pick which products a rule covers (all, or by SKU, category or brand), what to react to (lowest/highest/average competitor price, one specific competitor’s domain, Smart Price profiles, or your own price), what the new price should be (match, percentage or fixed-amount difference, or a fixed price, with optional rounding), and the price limits that are always enforced last.

Can prices ever go dangerously low — or absurdly high?

Not if you set price limits. A floor and a ceiling are applied after every rule, on every branch, so no rule can take a product below the margin you protect. On top of that, the plugin itself refuses any update it cannot apply unambiguously instead of guessing.

Which products can be updated?

Simple products and individual product variations, matched by SKU. The SKU must identify exactly one product. A variable product cannot be priced directly — use the SKU of each variation.

Which price is changed?

The plugin is sale-aware. A new price below the regular price becomes the sale price and your regular price is preserved; a new price at or above the regular price replaces the regular price and ends the sale.

A price update was not applied. Why?

The reason is listed under WooCommerce → Pricing Updater, in Recent price updates, and is also reported back to BlackAha. The usual causes are an unknown or duplicated SKU, a price in a different currency, or more decimals than your store uses.

The connection does not complete. What should I check?

Make sure your site is served over HTTPS and publicly reachable, then press Connect again — a new attempt issues fresh credentials and safely replaces any half-finished connection.

Is the connection secure?

Yes, by design. Updates are only delivered over HTTPS, every request is verified with your signing secret, must be recent, and cannot be replayed. The webhook address is random and unique to your store, and each update is applied exactly once even if it is delivered twice.

Is the signing secret safe?

The secret is stored on your server and is never displayed again after the connection is made — not in the admin, not in logs. If you ever reconnect, a new secret is issued and the old one stops working immediately.

Does the plugin send my store data to BlackAha?

Only what the connection needs: at connect time, your site’s address and the plugin’s own endpoint addresses; afterwards, the result of each price update (whether it was applied, and the price now in effect). Customer and order data are never read and never sent.

Can I protect some products from being updated?

Yes, in two ways: scope your rule sets in BlackAha so the products are never targeted, or use the pricing_updater_allow_price_update filter in your theme or a small plugin to block updates for specific products on the store side.

What happens to my data if I delete the plugin?

The connection stops working immediately, and the plugin’s settings and update log are removed from your site. Your products keep whatever prices they had at that moment — nothing is reverted or changed on uninstall.
sections.changelog:
1.2.1

  • Connecting no longer shows the WordPress login page on the way back from BlackAha, even with strict cookie or tracking protection.
  • The way back from BlackAha is faster: the connection is completed immediately and the browser is sent straight to the settings page.
  • “Connect manually” stays available on the settings page after connecting.

1.2.0

  • More reliable one-click connection: works on servers whose clock is off, and price updates are checked against BlackAha’s clock.
  • Every connection error now shows its own explanation, and a “Connect manually” option is offered after any failed or cancelled attempt.
  • Simpler settings page: no waiting screen. After approving, the page shows “Configuration successful” and where to run the connection test in BlackAha.

1.1.2

  • Settings page: removed the loading indicator from the “Configuration successful” card.

1.1.1

  • After approving, the store shows “Configuration successful” and points to the connection test in BlackAha; it shows “Connected” once that test arrives.
  • Checks that the site uses HTTPS on a public domain before contacting BlackAha.
  • Clearer messages for plan limits and too many attempts.
  • Webhook requests are authenticated before they reach the handler; no answer of the plugin is cached.

1.1.0

  • One-click connection: approve once in your BlackAha account, nothing to copy.
  • The webhook address is now random and unique to each store.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
